tagline.en: ₹6,000 per year directly to bank account for farmer families
tagline.hi: किसान परिवारों को हर साल ₹6,000 सीधे बैंक खाते में
tagline.mr: शेतकरी कुटुंबांसाठी दरवर्षी ₹६,००० थेट बँक खात्यात

eligibility: All small and marginal farmer families with cultivable land
Land ownership must be in the farmer's name in official land records
Aadhaar-seeded bank account and completed eKYC are compulsory
Institutional landholders and income tax paying professionals are not eligible
benefits: Financial benefit of ₹6,000 per year
Paid in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 every 4 months
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) straight into bank account
documents: Aadhaar Card
Land Ownership Documents (Khata / Khatauni / 7/12 extract)
Bank Account Passbook / Account details linked to Aadhaar
Active Mobile Number linked to Aadhaar
howToApply: Visit pmkisan.gov.in portal or your nearest CSC (Common Service Centre)
Click on 'New Farmer Registration' and enter your Aadhaar number
Upload your land details and bank passbook
Complete Aadhaar OTP based eKYC

tagline.en: ₹1,500 monthly financial aid for eligible women in Maharashtra
tagline.hi: महाराष्ट्र में पात्र महिलाओं को ₹1,500 प्रति माह आर्थिक सहायता
tagline.mr: महाराष्ट्रातील पात्र महिलांना दरमहा ₹१,५०० आर्थिक मदत

eligibility: Resident women of Maharashtra aged between 21 and 65 years
Married, unmarried, widowed, divorced, or destitute women
Annual family income must be under ₹2.5 Lakhs (or family possesses yellow/orange ration card)
No family member should be a regular government employee or income tax payer
benefits: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500 transferred directly to bank account
Annual total assistance of ₹18,000 per beneficiary
Supports nutrition, health, and economic independence of women
documents: Aadhaar Card
Maharashtra Domicile Certificate or Ration Card (Yellow/Orange)
Bank Account linked to Aadhaar with DBT enabled
Income Certificate (if not having yellow/orange ration card)
Self-declaration / Hamipatra
howToApply: Apply through the official Nari Shakti Doot app or portal
Or apply via Anganwadi Sevika, Gram Sevak, or Setu Suvidha Kendra
Submit Aadhaar, ration card, and bank details with biometric verification

name.hi: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
name.mr: आयुष्मान भारत - पंतप्रधान जन आरोग्य योजना

tagline.en: Free health treatment up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year
tagline.hi: हर पात्र परिवार को प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख तक का मुफ्त इलाज
tagline.mr: प्रत्येक कुटुंबाला दरवर्षी ₹५ लाखांपर्यंत मोफत उपचार

eligibility: Families identified under Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC 2011) rural and urban deprivation criteria
Active Rashtriya Swasthya Bima Yojana (RSBY) cardholders
All senior citizens aged 70 and above regardless of income (under Ayushman Vaya Vandana expansion)
No limit on family size, age, or gender
benefits: Cashless and paperless treatment up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year
Covers secondary and tertiary care hospitalization in all empanelled public and private hospitals across India
Includes 3 days pre-hospitalization and 15 days post-hospitalization expenses, medicines, and diagnostics
documents: Aadhaar Card or Government Photo ID
Ration Card or PM-JAY Family ID letter
Active Mobile number for OTP verification
howToApply: Check eligibility at beneficiary.nha.gov.in or call toll-free helpline 14555
Visit any empanelled government or private hospital or CSC center with your Aadhaar and Ration card
The Ayushman Mitra at hospital will verify KYC and issue your Ayushman Card immediately

tagline.en: Free LPG gas connection with first cylinder and stove for women
tagline.hi: गरीब परिवारों की महिलाओं को मुफ्त गैस कनेक्शन, पहला सिलेंडर और चूल्हा
tagline.mr: महिलांसाठी मोफत गॅस कनेक्शन, पहिला सिलेंडर आणि शेगडी

eligibility: Adult woman (aged 18+) belonging to poor households (BPL, SC/ST, PMAY, Antyodaya)
No other existing LPG connection in the same household
Migrant families can apply without submitting local address proof (self-declaration accepted)
benefits: Deposit-free LPG gas connection in the name of the female head of the family
First LPG cylinder refill completely free of cost
Free hotplate (stove) provided at the time of connection
Targeted subsidy of ₹300 per cylinder for up to 12 refills a year deposited via DBT
documents: Aadhaar Card of the applicant woman and adult family members
Ration Card or Family composition certificate
Bank Account details (Passbook) linked to Aadhaar
Active Mobile Number
howToApply: Apply online at pmuy.gov.in or visit the nearest LPG distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, or HP Gas)
Fill the Ujjwala 2.0 application form and attach Aadhaar and ration card copy
Distributor verifies details and issues connection within few days

tagline.en: Financial assistance to construct a pucca house with basic amenities
tagline.hi: पक्का मकान बनाने के लिए सीधी आर्थिक सहायता और सुविधाएं
tagline.mr: पक्के घर बांधण्यासाठी थेट आर्थिक मदत आणि सुविधा

eligibility: Families without a pucca house or living in zero, one, or two-room kutcha houses
Must not own a pucca house anywhere in India
Families selected through Gram Sabha validated SECC 2011 and Awaas+ surveys
Preference given to SC/ST, minorities, widows, and physically challenged persons
benefits: Direct grant of ₹1,20,000 in plain areas and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult states for house construction
Additional ₹12,000 financial support for toilet construction under Swachh Bharat Mission
90 to 95 days of unskilled labor wages under MGNREGA (~₹25,000)
Piped drinking water, electricity connection, and LPG under other convergence schemes
documents: Aadhaar Card
Bank Account details with DBT enabled
MGNREGA Job Card Number
Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM) registration number
Land / homestead site ownership papers or certificate
howToApply: For PMAY-Gramin: Name is registered by Gram Panchayat / Panchayat Secretary through AwaasSoft app
For PMAY-Urban: Apply online via pmaymis.gov.in or visit nearest CSC center with income and land documents
Geo-tagged photos of construction stages are verified before each installment release

tagline.en: High-interest savings scheme for girl child with tax-free returns
tagline.hi: बेटियों के उज्ज्वल भविष्य के लिए सबसे ज्यादा ब्याज वाली बचत योजना
tagline.mr: मुलींच्या सुरक्षित भविष्यासाठी सर्वाधिक व्याजाची बचत योजना

eligibility: Account can be opened by parents/guardians for a girl child from birth up to 10 years of age
Maximum two accounts per family (one per girl child; exception for twins/triplets)
Child must be an Indian citizen and resident
benefits: Highest government small-savings interest rate (currently 8.2% per annum, compounded annually)
Start with as little as ₹250 per year (maximum ₹1.5 Lakh per year)
Complete tax exemption under Section 80C on deposit, interest earned, and final maturity amount
Account matures after 21 years or upon girl's marriage after age 18; 50% withdrawal allowed for higher education after age 18
documents: Birth Certificate of the girl child
Identity Proof (Aadhaar / PAN / Voter ID) of the parent/guardian
Address Proof of parent/guardian
Passport size photographs of child and parent
howToApply: Visit any Post Office branch or authorized public/private commercial bank
Fill the Sukanya Samriddhi Account Opening Form-1
Submit child's birth certificate and KYC documents with initial deposit (minimum ₹250)
A physical passbook is issued for recording all deposits and interest
